newsitem.title: USA: 360 says rates, fraud costs to impact Q1.
newsitem.headline: 360 says rates, fraud costs to impact Q1.

text.p: 360 Communications Co said Tuesday its new roaming rates are expected to reduce operating revenues by $4-$5 million in the first quarter.

The company also said that as previously announced, it incurred cellular fraud losses mostly in December that were $6 million higher than its historical cellular fraud level of one percent of service revenues.
Although cellular fraud activity has declined each month since, it is expected to average about $3 million per month in the first quarter, 360 said.

"360 is experiencing robust customer growth and, as a result of that growth, our first quarter results will be affected by higher acquisition costs," said Dennis Foster, president and chief executive.
360, a wireless voice and data company, said it expects customer growth in the first quarter to exceed its customer gain of 94,000 during the first quarter of 1996.
The company is to report first-quarter results April 15.
